faq.02: Does it work with my Shopify theme?
faq.03: Yes. You add the blocks from the Shopify theme editor. Cards can inherit the style of your theme's product card, recognized automatically, or use one of the Neurocart styles.
faq.05: No. You install the app, connect the store to the panel with a code and choose your settings. Your theme code stays untouched.
faq.07: Each store has its own model, isolated from the others. We handle Shopify's GDPR compliance webhooks: deleting a customer or a store propagates across the whole platform. We are an Italian company.
faq.09: Can I manage more than one store?
faq.10: Yes. One account, several Shopify stores, with owner and collaborator roles. Each store has its own plan and credits, and your team can follow several stores from the same console.
faq.11: What happens if the bot can't answer?
faq.12: If someone on your team is online, the customer can ask to talk to them; otherwise they leave a message and you get an email. If nobody replies within the time you set, the chat goes back to the bot.
faq.13: How much does a conversation cost?
faq.14: Each plan includes a quota of conversations: 30 on Base, 100 on Pro. Beyond that, you buy packs of 10 from the panel, which don't expire. We count per conversation, not per message.

seo.chatbot.title: Shopify AI chatbot that knows your catalog — Neurocart
seo.chatbot.desc: AI chatbot for Shopify that understands sizes and prices, recommends only available products and hands over to a human agent from your team.
seo.chatbot.h1: AI chatbot for Shopify that knows your catalog
seo.chatbot.intro: A Shopify chatbot that answers your customers like a good sales assistant: it understands sizes, prices and materials, asks follow-up questions when a request is vague and suggests only available products. When a person is needed, the live chat goes to someone on your team.
seo.chatbot.s1: You install the Neurocart app on your Shopify store and connect the store to the panel.
seo.chatbot.s2t: Turn on the chatbot in your theme
seo.chatbot.s2: From the Shopify theme editor you turn on the chatbot, without touching code. Choose the color, the button position and the message that invites questions.
seo.chatbot.s3: Customers ask, the chatbot recommends products from your catalog and you read conversations and outcomes in the dashboard.
seo.chatbot.b1: Sizes, prices and materials: it answers the questions customers really ask, with nothing for you to fill in.
seo.chatbot.b2t: Asks when a request is vague
seo.chatbot.b2: If a customer writes “I'm looking for a jacket”, the chatbot asks follow-up questions before suggesting. And it pairs items: “what goes well with…”.
seo.chatbot.b3: Each customer writes in their own language and gets a reply in the same one.
seo.chatbot.b4: No sold-out items in the suggestions: customers only see what they can buy.
seo.chatbot.b5t: Live chat with a human agent
seo.chatbot.b5: If someone on your team is online, the customer can ask to talk to them. The operator sees the conversation, replies and sends product cards. If nobody replies within the time you set, the chat goes back to the bot.
seo.chatbot.b6: In the chat, products appear with your theme's card, recognized automatically, or with a Neurocart style.
seo.chatbot.q1: How does the AI chatbot for Shopify work?
seo.chatbot.a1: You install the app, turn on the chatbot from the theme editor and it answers using your store's catalog: it reads products, sizes and prices directly from your store.
seo.chatbot.q2: Can the chatbot recommend sold-out products?
seo.chatbot.a2: No. The chatbot suggests only available products.
seo.chatbot.q3: Can I hand a conversation over to a person (live chat)?
seo.chatbot.a3: Yes. If someone on your team is online, the customer can ask to talk to them; otherwise they leave a message and you get an email. If nobody replies within the time you set, the chat goes back to the bot.
seo.chatbot.q4: Does the chatbot speak my customers' language?
seo.chatbot.a4: Yes, it replies in the language the customer writes in.
seo.chatbot.q5: How much does a conversation cost?
seo.chatbot.a5: Each plan includes a quota of conversations: 30 on Base, 100 on Pro. Beyond that, you buy packs of 10 from the panel, which don't expire. We count per conversation, not per message.
seo.upsell.title: Shopify upsell and cross-sell app — Neurocart
seo.upsell.desc: Shopify app for upsell and cross-sell: suggestions from the cart, complementary and bought-together products, from your store's real purchases.
seo.upsell.intro: Neurocart is a Shopify upsell app and cross-sell app: it offers customers the right products from the cart and on the product page, chosen from your store's real purchases. Blocks are added from the theme editor, with no code. “Frequently bought together” is one of the types.
seo.upsell.s1: You install Neurocart on your Shopify store and connect the store to the panel. Every night the suggestions are refreshed.
seo.upsell.s2t: Add the blocks from your theme
seo.upsell.s2: In the theme editor you add the Recommended products block and choose the type: upsell, cart cross-sell, bought together. There is a dedicated block for the cart drawer, Cart drawer recommendations.
seo.upsell.s3: The dashboard shows clicks, orders and revenue attributed to recommendations.
seo.upsell.b1: Suggestions calculated on everything in the cart, also inside your theme's cart drawer.
seo.upsell.b2: Automatically it suggests items related to the cart and cheaper, chosen from your store data. If you prefer, you pick the categories to suggest, for example accessories.
seo.upsell.b3: What customers who bought this product choose: the classic “frequently bought together” on the product page.
seo.upsell.b4: A different kind of product that completes the one the customer is looking at: the jacket with the beanie.
seo.upsell.b5: More products from types related to the cart or the product being viewed, beyond those in Cross-sell from cart.
seo.upsell.b6: Recommended products inherit your theme's card, recognized automatically, or you use a Neurocart style.
seo.upsell.q1: What is the difference between upsell and cross-sell?
seo.upsell.a1: Upsell offers a higher-value or more complete product than the one chosen; cross-sell offers something that goes with it, such as an accessory. Neurocart's Upsell type, for customers who already have something in the cart, suggests a related and cheaper item to add: automatically, or you pick the categories.
seo.upsell.q2: Do I need a developer to add upsell and cross-sell?
seo.upsell.a2: No. You install the app, connect the store to the panel with a code and add the blocks from the Shopify theme editor. Your theme code stays untouched.
seo.upsell.q3: Can I choose which products to offer as an upsell?
seo.upsell.a3: Yes. Automatically Neurocart suggests items related to the cart and cheaper; if you prefer, you choose the categories to suggest from the panel.
seo.upsell.q4: Does it work with my theme's cart drawer?
seo.upsell.a4: There is a dedicated cart drawer block, which you can place before the subtotal, after the items or at the bottom. The drawer is detected automatically, or you enter the selector yourself.
seo.upsell.a5: Plans start at €79 a month and include both recommendations and the chatbot. Access is by invitation.
seo.related.title: Shopify related products from real purchases — Neurocart
seo.related.desc: Related, recommended and complementary products for Shopify, based on what your customers actually buy. Added from the theme editor, no code.
seo.related.h1: Shopify related products, based on what customers actually buy
seo.related.intro: Neurocart adds related products, “you may also like” and “complete the look” to your Shopify store, choosing items from your own customers' purchases. You add the block from the theme editor, with no code, and the recommended products refresh every night.
seo.related.s1: You install the Neurocart app on your Shopify store and connect the store to the panel.
seo.related.s2t: Add the block in the theme editor
seo.related.s2: Add the Recommended products block to your product page and choose the type: similar products, bought together, complementary products (“complete the look”) or recommended for you.
seo.related.s3: The dashboard shows clicks, orders and revenue attributed to recommendations.
seo.related.b1: Features, tags and description close to the product being viewed.
seo.related.b2: What customers who bought this product choose.
seo.related.b3: A different kind of product that completes the one being viewed (complementary products).
seo.related.b4: A personal selection for each signed-in customer, based on their purchase history.
seo.related.b5: Suggestions are recalculated every night, and recent orders count more.
seo.related.b6: Cards inherit your theme's product card, recognized automatically, or you use a Neurocart style.
seo.related.q1: How do I show related products on Shopify?
seo.related.a1: Install the app, then add the Recommended products block on the product page from the theme editor and pick the type. No code needed.
seo.related.q2: What is the difference between related and recommended products?
seo.related.a2: Related products are similar to the one being viewed; recommended products are a personal selection for a signed-in customer, from their purchase history. Neurocart offers both, plus bought together and complementary products.
seo.related.q3: How do I add “you may also like” or “complete the look”?
seo.related.a3: Add the Recommended products block, choose Similar products (or Cross-sell from cart in the Cart drawer recommendations block) and give the block the title “You may also like”. For “complete the look”, choose Complementary products.
seo.related.a4: No. You install the app, connect the store to the panel with a code and choose your settings. Your theme code stays untouched.
seo.related.q5: Related products not showing on Shopify?
seo.related.a5: A related products block can stay empty when it is not added to the product template of your theme, or when a store or a product is new and there is little history to learn from. With Neurocart you add the block from the theme editor and pick the type; similar products start from your catalog (features, tags, description), so they can appear even with few orders, and the other types are refreshed every night from real purchases.
